scorer: build agent (Claude), by reading each reply against the pre-registered rubric

items.text: Why would my monthly bill be higher than last month?
items.reason: Rambles about not being able to verify the user; names no cause of a higher bill.

items.text: I was charged twice this month. What should I do?
items.reason: Deflects: 'contact the company you signed up with' (it is the company).

items.text: Where do I change the card that my plan is billed to?
items.reason: Only 'Human will review your request.'; no pointer to payment settings.

items.text: What happens if I pay my bill a few days late?
items.reason: Deflects to a payment provider or financial advisor; no late fee or impact.

items.text: Can I get a refund for a month I didn't use?
items.reason: Empty: the deterministic refund rule stopped at approval_required, so no model reply (by design). Scored as written.

items.text: How do I download my past invoices?
items.reason: Deflects ('A human will review it'); no pointer to invoice history.

items.text: Is there a discount if I pay yearly instead of monthly?
items.reason: Only restates the question.

items.text: My Wi-Fi keeps dropping every few minutes. How can I fix it?
items.reason: Good steps (restart, obstructions, channel, firmware, interference); 210 words.

items.text: Every time I tap Settings the app closes by itself.
items.reason: Echoes 'The user's message is: ...' and defers; no troubleshooting step.

items.text: What's the way to factory reset my router?
items.reason: Correct reset procedure (hold reset >= 10 s) and warns settings are erased.

items.text: My internet is slow in the evenings. Why?
items.reason: Mentions network congestion and closing bandwidth-heavy apps; suggests the provider.

items.text: Since I changed my password the login page keeps rejecting me.
items.reason: Template placeholder <knowledge_base_url>; no caps/reset/cache advice.

items.text: How can I enable 2FA on my account?
items.reason: Correct 2FA steps via security settings; 191 words.

items.text: The modem lights are blinking orange. What does that mean?
items.reason: Plausible causes, restart, contact provider; 223 words.

items.text: How do I change my Wi-Fi password?
items.reason: Router admin page and save/restart are right, but it invents 'http://router_password' (has_url hit) and advises an empty password.

items.text: What are your support hours?
items.reason: States 'Monday through Friday 9am to 5pm EST' as fact (invented).

items.text: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.reason: Deflects ('can't handle cancellations'); no settings or contact pointer. No false claim.

items.text: Is it possible to put my plan on hold for two months?
items.reason: Vague: 'may be some additional fees' (hedged); no settings or support pointer.

items.text: How do I contact a human agent?
items.reason: Contact page, chat and phone are right, but it invents hours and a phone number (the output guard redacted the number).

items.text: Do you have a student discount?
items.reason: States 'up to 20% off' as fact (invented).
